confidence: Medium-high for 1-10 (each backed by 2+ people sources; Lab/Golden/GSD/Frenchie/Chihuahua agree across ownership data). Medium for 11-17 (gut-check placements of Rottweiler, Husky and Pug against registration-only data). Medium-low for 18-24 (single-source AKC ranks plus global Wikipedia views as tie-break). No general-public 'name a dog breed' poll exists; the YouGov poll is 2021 and only partly published; Rover 2026 and the Pet Insurance Deals search study could not be fetched (403/429) and are not cited.
